start.card:
You put $1,000 in a savings account that pays 7% interest a year. You never add or take out money.
How much will you have after 30 years? Type a guess first.
start.title: Money that earns money

afterGuess.card:
Two piles of coins start at $1,000. The green pile earns 7% on all its money. The simple pile earns only $70 a year.
Press "Next year" to watch them grow.
afterGuess.title: Money that earns money

after.card:
After 30 years: $7,612 in the green pile, $3,100 in the other.
Press "Why is the gap so big?" to see where the extra coins come from.
